items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Old Man Kimball was on the bass, and Hande was on the sax, George Clark and Edward Botley, and myself on the band.

ctx.x: And Morris French was on the trombone, Roy Evans was on the drums, Old Man Kimball was on the bass, and Hande was on the sax, George Clark and Edward Botley, and myself on the band.
It was two good siblings, George Clark and Edward Botley was talking about.
